# Val Town

Skills that teach agents to work with Val Town. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [val-town/plugins](https://github.com/val-town/plugins), at commit `555ff74`.

Build and deploy on Val Town. Bundles the Val Town MCP server and platform skills (HTTP vals, cron/intervals, SQLite, email, OAuth, React UI, third-party integrations).

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Val Town**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Val Town**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install valtown@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

11 skills: `blob-storage`, `client-side-js`, `create-skill`, `cron-and-intervals`, `email`, `http-endpoints`, `oauth`, `react-ui`, `restricted-access`, `sqlite-storage`, `third-party-integrations`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
